verdict.rationale: ClickUp's core product is task management with API docs confirming create/update tasks (clickup-docs-28), assignees and due dates being standard fields manageable via API and UI, plus custom fields, views, and comments support. Community evidence corroborates it as a functioning task/issue tracker despite complaints about bloat/performance. Missing for 10: explicit citation of assignee/due-date fields in the evidence pack and independent hands-on confirmation of assignment workflows.
